schoolDivisionId.name: Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
schoolDivisionId.about:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering with specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning educates more than 1,000 undergraduate and postgraduate students to design, build and deploy intelligent systems. It pairs strong computing foundations with industry-mentored projects, active research and close personal mentoring.
The department is part of the School of Computing at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli, a campus of the NAAC A++ accredited SRMIST. Its students come from Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and other states; nearly half are from outside Tamil Nadu, and about one in three is a woman. Over 90% of the faculty hold a Ph.D., and their work spans computer vision, medical imaging, natural language processing, edge AI and intelligent IoT systems.

schoolDivisionId.name: Department of Big Data Analytics and Data Science
schoolDivisionId.about:
In a world where every digital interaction generates data and every connected system contributes to an ever-expanding information landscape, the ability to analyse, interpret, and harness data has become a driving force for innovation and informed decision-making. The Department of Big Data Analytics and Data Science brings together the foundations of Computer Science, the analytical power of Data Science, and the capabilities of Big Data technologies to prepare students to transform vast and complex datasets into meaningful insights, intelligent solutions, and real-world impact.

The department focuses on developing students’ abilities to understand data, identify patterns, uncover hidden opportunities, and address complex challenges through data-driven thinking. The learning environment integrates data science, statistical analysis, machine learning, data management, Big Data technologies, data visualisation, cloud-based analytics, and intelligent systems. Students gain exposure to the complete data lifecycle, from collecting and processing information to analysing large-scale datasets, communicating insights effectively, and applying analytical outcomes to practical challenges.

The curriculum encourages exploration across diverse domains, including business, healthcare, finance, the Internet of Things (IoT), intelligent systems, and emerging technology applications. Students are also encouraged to understand how data moves through interconnected systems, how large-scale information can support strategic decisions, and how analytical technologies can create value for organisations and society. Through hands-on learning, projects, internships, research, and industry-oriented initiatives, they develop the technical expertise, analytical mindset, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities required to address evolving technological challenges.

With dedicated faculty, a dynamic learning environment, and a strong emphasis on innovation, research, and continuous learning, the department strives to nurture a new generation of data scientists, Big Data professionals, technology innovators, and responsible problem solvers who can transform data into knowledge, knowledge into actionable intelligence, and intelligence into meaningful impact across an increasingly data-driven world.

message:
Big Data Analytics and Data Science have emerged as key areas of Computer Science, enabling organisations to process vast amounts of data, uncover meaningful patterns, generate actionable insights, and support informed decision-making. As data continues to grow in volume, variety, and complexity, the ability to combine large-scale data processing with statistical analysis, predictive modelling, and intelligent computational techniques has become increasingly valuable across business, technology, and emerging application domains.

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering with Specialization in Big Data Analytics and Data Science is committed to preparing students for this data-driven landscape through a curriculum that integrates strong foundations in Computer Science with specialised learning in Big Data technologies, data management, data warehousing and mining, statistical methods, machine learning, predictive analytics, cloud computing, streaming analytics, business intelligence, and data visualization.

The programme provides students with opportunities to explore the applications of Big Data Analytics and Data Science in emerging areas such as healthcare, finance, the Internet of Things, artificial intelligence, and other data-intensive domains. Project work, MOOCs, major projects, and industry internships further enable students to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges, develop analytical thinking, and transform complex datasets into meaningful insights and innovative solutions.

Our focus is to develop graduates equipped with the technical expertise, analytical capabilities, and problem-solving skills required to take up technical and managerial roles, pursue higher education and research, contribute as entrepreneurs, and adapt to evolving technologies in Big Data Analytics and Data Science.
facultyScopeName: Department of Big Data Analytics and Data Science

schoolDivisionId.name: Department of Information Technology
schoolDivisionId.about:
The Department of Information Technology at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli, is committed to providing high-quality education in computing and information technology while fostering innovation, research, entrepreneurship and professional excellence.
The Department functions within the School of Computing, which offers a broad portfolio of computing programmes including Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Cyber Security, Blockchain Technology, Internet of Things, Data Science, Computer Science and Business Systems, and Information Technology. The School's academic framework emphasizes fundamental computing disciplines such as algorithms, data structures, operating systems, computer networks, database systems, software engineering, distributed systems and cloud architectures. 
The Department of Information Technology focuses on preparing students to design, develop, deploy and manage technology solutions for real-world problems. The learning environment combines theoretical foundations with practical implementation, enabling students to understand not only how technologies work, but also how they can be integrated to solve complex organizational and societal challenges.
The programme is designed around the evolving landscape of information technology and provides students with opportunities to explore software development, databases, networking, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cybersecurity, mobile technologies, web technologies and emerging digital platforms

message:
Information Technology has become a fundamental enabler of innovation, digital transformation and sustainable development across every sector of society. From intelligent software systems and cloud platforms to cybersecurity, data-driven applications, artificial intelligence and next-generation digital services, IT professionals play a vital role in shaping the future.At the Department of Information Technology, our endeavour is to provide students with a strong foundation in computing and engineering while preparing them to address the rapidly changing requirements of the technology industry. We believe that meaningful education goes beyond acquiring technical knowledge; it involves developing the ability to analyse problems, design innovative solutions, work collaboratively, communicate effectively and act with professional and ethical responsibility.
Our academic approach integrates strong fundamentals, hands-on learning, emerging technologies, project-based education and industry exposure. Students are encouraged to transform concepts learned in the classroom into practical solutions through laboratory exercises, coding activities, internships, hackathons, technical events, interdisciplinary projects and major projects.The curriculum provides a comprehensive progression from programming, mathematics and fundamental engineering sciences to advanced areas such as data structures and algorithms, object-oriented programming, database management systems, computer networks, operating systems, software engineering, compiler design, information theory, mobile application development, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud computing, cybersecurity, full-stack development and other emerging technologies. The current SRMIST curriculum also provides opportunities for students to select discipline-specific and multidisciplinary electives, enabling them to build learning pathways aligned with their career aspirations. 
Our vision is to nurture technically competent, creative, adaptable and socially responsible IT professionals who can contribute meaningfully to industry, research, entrepreneurship and society. With the continuous evolution of technology, we encourage our students to become lifelong learners who are capable of adapting to new tools, platforms and paradigms.
I invite prospective students, parents, industry professionals, researchers and academic partners to explore the opportunities offered by the Department of Information Technology at SRM IST Tiruchirappalli. Together, let us empower the next generation of technology professionals to innovate, create and transform the digital future.

We encourage curiosity, discipline, teamwork, communication, problem-solving and career readiness. schoolDivisionId.name: Division of Physics
schoolDivisionId.about: The Physics Department in our SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli Campus serves as a cornerstone for developing a strong scientific foundation among students across all branches of engineering. With a team of highly qualified faculty members, laboratories, and a commitment to fostering innovation, the department integrates fundamental physics principles with practical applications relevant to modern technology and engineering challenges. Through a well-structured curriculum, cutting-edge research opportunities, and hands-on experiments, students gain critical analytical and problem-solving skills essential for their professional growth. The department also encourages interdisciplinary collaborations, enabling students to apply physics concepts in emerging areas such as Photonics, Quantum Optics, Energy storage devices, Material Science, Nanomaterials, Plasma, and Quantum information processing. message:

It is my immense privilege and joy to welcome you to the Division of Physics at the Faculty of Engineering and Technology, SRMIST Tiruchirappalli. I invite you to explore, question, collaborate, and grow with us. The Division of Physics at SRMIST Tiruchirappalli stands ready to support your ambitions, fuel your intellectual curiosity, and help you make your mark on the world of science and beyond. Together, let us push the boundaries of what is known — and discover what is yet to come.
Warm regards,

schoolDivisionId.name: Division of Mathematics
schoolDivisionId.about: Established in 2021, the Department of Mathematics at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli, serves as a cornerstone of academic excellence, logical reasoning, and analytical innovation across engineering, technology, and science disciplines. The department brings together a vibrant team of highly accomplished faculty members actively engaged in cutting-edge research across diverse pure and applied domains, including Analysis & Differential Equations, Mathematical Finance and Inverse Problems, Fuzzy Set Theory & Graph Theory, Mathematical Modelling & Optimization, and Queueing Theory & Stochastic Processes. Driven by a commitment to interdisciplinary integration, the department empowers students to translate abstract mathematical principles into actionable solutions for complex socio-economic, technological, and real-world industrial challenges. By fostering critical thinking and problem-solving rigor, the Department of Mathematics prepares future engineers, scientists, and industry leaders to innovate and excel in an increasingly data-driven global ecosystem.

message: “Mathematics is the language through which we understand patterns, formulate ideas and create solutions.” It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Mathematics at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli. At the Department of Mathematics, we are committed to nurturing this foundation through excellence in teaching, meaningful learning experiences and a strong culture of research and innovation. In keeping with the broader vision of SRMIST to advance knowledge through a rigorous academic and research environment, our Department strives to provide students with a learning ecosystem that combines conceptual clarity, analytical reasoning and practical application. Our teaching-learning practices go beyond conventional classroom instruction. We encourage students to explore mathematical ideas through computational tools, technology-enabled learning, problem-solving activities and interdisciplinary applications. The objective is to help students understand not only how a mathematical method works, but also where and why it can be applied. We believe that Mathematics develops more than computational ability—it cultivates precision, logical thinking, perseverance and the confidence to approach complex problems systematically. These qualities are essential for success in higher education, research and the rapidly evolving technological world. I invite students, researchers, academicians and industry professionals to engage with the Department and become part of our journey towards academic excellence, innovation and meaningful contributions through Mathematics.

message:
Welcome to the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering!
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli. Electrical and Electronics Engineering is at the heart of modern technological transformation, contributing significantly to sustainable energy, intelligent systems, electric mobility, advanced power systems, and the development of future energy networks.
Our department is committed to providing quality education, practical learning, technical excellence, innovation, research, and industry exposure, enabling students to develop strong technical and professional competencies. 
Research and innovation are integral to our academic environment. The department offers Ph.D. programmes in both Full-Time and Part-Time modes, providing opportunities for aspiring researchers and working professionals to pursue advanced research in emerging areas of Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
We place strong emphasis on developing students with the technical knowledge, practical skills, and professional competencies required by core electrical and allied industries. Through hands-on training, technical projects, laboratory practice, industry interactions, expert sessions, internships, and technical competitions, students are encouraged to build careers in core industries, power and energy sectors, electric mobility, renewable energy, automation, power electronics, and research and development organisations.
Our department provides a strong laboratory-oriented learning environment that enables students to transform theoretical concepts into practical applications. The laboratories support experiential learning, experimentation, simulation, design, testing, and project development. These facilities encourage students to develop practical solutions to real-world engineering challenges and strengthen their readiness for industry and research careers.
As part of the Study Abroad Programme (SAP), students also have opportunities to visit foreign universities and institutions during their programme, gaining valuable international academic exposure, experiencing different educational environments, interacting with global peers, and developing a broader perspective of engineering and technology.
Through Electronova – the Department Students’ Association and our three technical clubs — Teslaverse, Voltex, and Fluxon — students are provided with opportunities to participate in hands-on workshops, technical events, competitions, expert interactions, projects, innovation activities, and industry-oriented learning experiences. These platforms nurture technical skills, creativity, teamwork, leadership, communication, and problem-solving abilities beyond the classroom.
We strive to create an engaging, research-driven, industry-oriented, and globally connected learning environment where every student is encouraged to learn, innovate, lead, and contribute to society. Through quality education, advanced laboratory facilities, research opportunities, industry engagement, international exposure, and continuous innovation, the department aims to prepare competent engineers, researchers, and future technology leaders capable of addressing the technological and societal challenges of tomorrow.

schoolDivisionId.name: Department of Cyber security
schoolDivisionId.about:
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering with Specialization in Cyber security at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli Campus, is committed to providing quality technical education, fostering research and innovation, and developing industry-ready professionals capable of addressing the rapidly evolving challenges of the digital world. The department strives to create a dynamic academic environment that integrates theoretical foundations, practical expertise, emerging technologies, and professional ethics.
The department offers a comprehensive undergraduate learning experience combining the fundamental principles of Computer Science and Engineering with specialized knowledge in Cyber security, Network Security, Ethical Hacking, Cryptography, Digital Forensics, Cloud Computing, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Internet of Things (IoT) Security. Through outcome-based education, innovative teaching methodologies, and experiential learning practices, students are encouraged to develop analytical thinking, technical proficiency, creativity, and problem-solving capabilities.
The department is supported by  highly qualified faculty members, all holding Ph.D. degrees, with expertise in Cyber security, Networking, Cloud Computing, Distributed Systems, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and interdisciplinary computing applications. Faculty members actively contribute to scholarly publications, patent initiatives, research supervision, technical training, and professional development activities. The department's research-oriented academic environment promotes collaborative learning, knowledge creation, and technological advancement.
A distinguishing strength of the department is its emphasis on industry-integrated education and practical skill development. Industry engagement with organizations such as Fortinet and Cisco provides opportunities to strengthen practical knowledge and professional competencies. The department's Fortinet industry laboratory resources, including FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, and FortiSIEM, support learning in network security, threat monitoring, security analysis, and security operations. Industry-supported activities help bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world technological requirements.
The department actively promotes student engagement through its technical clubs, along with professional platforms such as ACM and IEEE student chapters. These initiatives encourage participation in Capture the Flag (CTF) competitions, ethical hacking challenges, cybersecurity awareness programmes, technical workshops, peer learning, and collaborative problem-solving activities.
With a strong commitment to academic excellence, industry exposure, innovation, and professional ethics, the department aims to nurture technically competent, socially responsible, and globally competitive engineers capable of contributing to the development of a secure and resilient digital ecosystem

message: Cyber security is fundamental to building a secure, resilient, and trustworthy digital world. At the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber security), SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli Campus, we are committed to nurturing the next generation of cyber security leaders through academic excellence, research-driven learning, technological innovation, and meaningful industry collaboration. Our multidisciplinary approach integrates strong computing foundations with emerging domains such as cyber defence, network security, ethical hacking, digital forensics, cloud security, and artificial intelligence. Through experiential learning, advanced security technologies, industry engagement, and real-world problem-solving, we empower students to develop critical thinking, technical expertise, and ethical responsibility. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and collaborative academic environment that inspires discovery, encourages innovation, and prepares graduates to address complex global cyber security challenges. Our vision is to develop globally competent professionals and researchers who advance digital trust, safeguard critical infrastructure, and shape a safer and more secure digital future.

schoolDivisionId.name: Food Technology
schoolDivisionId.about: In a world facing unprecedented population growth and climate volatility, the scope of Food Technology extends far beyond simple processing. It is the critical bridge between agricultural production and human health. Our department recognizes Food Technologists as the architects of global health—professionals who engineer functional foods, ensure the highest standards of safety, and optimize the nutritional value of what the world eats. The food industry remains one of the largest and most resilient economic sectors globally. Our department is committed to meeting this immense industry capacity by producing skilled professionals who are ready to lead in multinational corporations, reputed research & development facilities, and entrepreneurial ventures. Throughout their studies, students are exposed to a wide range of opportunities including international workshops, industry-led internships, and intensive in-plant training in modern pilot plants. Our curriculum is meticulously designed to merge the fundamental principles of Biological Sciences with Advanced Engineering, preparing students to address the complex challenges of the 21st-century food supply chain.

message:
I am honored to welcome you to the Department of Food Technology at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Tiruchirappalli. As the Head of the Department, I take great pride in leading a vibrant academic community dedicated to solving one of the world’s most critical challenges: ensuring a safe, sustainable, and nutritious food supply for a growing global population. The Department of Food Technology is committed to nurturing innovative professionals equipped with a deep understanding of food chemistry, engineering, and nutrition. Our curriculum establishes a robust foundation in core disciplines such as food processing, preservation, quality control, and safety management. By integrating these fundamentals with advanced domains like Industry 4.0, Smart Packaging, Functional Foods, and Bio-resource Technology, we empower our students to design scalable and intelligent solutions for the modern food industry. Supported by a team of highly qualified faculty and an active research environment, our department focuses on emerging frontiers such as Precision Fermentation, Sustainable Protein Alternatives, and Advanced Packaging Materials. Our goal is to develop competent professionals with strong ethical values and leadership qualities who will contribute meaningfully to global food security and technological advancement.
I invite you to join the Department of Food Technology and embark on an exciting journey of knowledge, innovation, and excellence. Together, let us engineer a healthier and more sustainable future for society.
